evidence: EXEC CICS SEND MAP MAPSET FREEKB CURSOR ERASE

purpose.domain_detail: Demo online CICS transaction program (comment says 'Programme demo ONLINE'); interacts with a DB2 table VTBMSGA and a message-retrieval subprogram CALLMSG
purpose.summary: A CICS online transaction program named ONLINE1 that handles a BMS map (ONLINEF/ONLINE1), performs first-pass and second-pass screen logic, validates input, optionally queries a DB2 table, and returns to transaction TRA1. It is explicitly described as a demo program in the source comments.

notable_features: EXEC CICS (BMS map send/receive, XCTL, LINK, RETURN with TRANSID/COMMAREA, ABEND, SYNCPOINT, ADDRESS TCTUA)
EXEC SQL (INCLUDE SQLCA, INCLUDE table, WHENEVER SQLERROR GOTO, SELECT commented out)
DFHCOMMAREA with OCCURS DEPENDING ON EIBCALEN
TCTUA addressing via ADDRESS OF TUA-ZONE
French-language comments and variable names (W-JOUR, W-MOIS, W-ANNEE, 1ER-PASSAGE, 2EME-PASSAGE)
HEX80 sentinel value using latin-1 character
REDEFINES for date and time overlays
verdict.notes: File decoded with latin-1; French comments and identifiers suggest a French-speaking development shop. The SQL SELECT is commented out, suggesting the DB2 logic is partially stubbed. Max line length is exactly 72, confirming fixed-format. Program is labelled 'demo' in comments but the structure and coding style are production-quality.
